name: Darkish Pink
lede: Darkish Pink is a strong, warm rose pink, named by the plainest possible grammar: the modifier "darkish" applied straight to pink, with no catalog behind it that we can find.

sections.title: A plain description, nothing more
sections.body: The name describes itself: *darkish* softens *dark*, applied to [[pink]] [1]. No Ridgway plate, ISCC-NBS block or Maerz and Paul entry in our sources lists Darkish Pink, and the library carries no record of who coined it or when [1]. Its nearest named neighbor on file is [[ruber]], almost the same at 2.5 CIEDE2000 units, with [[dark-pink|Dark Pink]], a plainer-named near-twin, close behind at 4.7 units [2]. The closest cut-gem match on file is a bright commercial [[gem:ruby|ruby]] [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive holds this pink covering at least 1 percent of its canvas, within four CIEDE2000 units of it, as photographed [4]. That describes a gap in this particular archive, not pink in painting generally [4]. It is one of the few named colors here with no strong field match to report at all [4].
